title: HR Business Partner
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As Everpure continues to grow and evolve, we are looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to support our organisation in France.

As the primary HR partner on the ground in France, you will support leaders and managers across a broad range of people matters, combining day-to-day operational HR partnership with more strategic people initiatives.

You will work with a high degree of ownership and independence in your day-to-day role, while being well supported by the wider EMEA HR team, including HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Total Rewards and Learning & Development. You will also partner closely with internal and external Legal Counsel on complex employee relations. In this role you will also be the sole HR contact for French  Works Council matters.

This role is ideal for an HR Business Partner who enjoys variety, building strong relationships with the business and taking ownership for local HR delivery, while working collaboratively as part of a wider regional and international team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Strategic Business Partnership: Act as the primary HR advisor for leaders across France, Italy, and Spain, translating business objectives into effective people strategies while proactively identifying and addressing regional trends, talent risks, and organizational challenges.

• Employee & Labour Relations: Manage the full spectrum of complex employee relations, including performance, disciplinary, and grievance issues; serve as the dedicated HR contact for French Works Council (CSE) engagement, ensuring full compliance with local employment law and internal policies.

• Talent & Organizational Effectiveness: Lead high-impact talent reviews, succession planning, and performance management cycles that foster an inclusive culture, retain critical talent, and drive business performance within the South region.

• Operational Delivery & Process Improvement: Balance day-to-day HR support with the implementation of global and regional people programs, partnering closely with EMEA HR Operations to optimize the employee lifecycle, HR administration, and process efficiency.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Paris office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• HR Domain Expertise: Extensive background as an HR Business Partner or broad HR Generalist, ideally within a matrixed technology or sales-driven environment, with advanced working knowledge of French employment law and modern HR practices.

• Coaching & Influence: Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with managers, coach leadership through complex organizational decisions, and operate with a pragmatic, commercially minded approach.

• Problem-Solving & Judgement: Strong judgment in navigating high-risk employee relations matters, with a proven ability to manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and discern precisely when to escalate to legal or specialist teams.

• Communication & Collaboration: Essential fluency in both French and English (written and verbal) is required to collaborate effectively with local teams, regional stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.

title: Addetto/a Vendite e Formazione sul Campo (Part-Time) — Sephora Milan (m/f/x)
description:
Chi è Yepoda

Innovazione K-Beauty pulita. Senza compromessi.

Yepoda è un marchio di clean K-Beauty che dimostra davvero la sua efficacia. Realizziamo skincare coreana senza alcun compromesso: testata clinicamente, 100% vegana e formulata al di sopra degli standard UE. Otterrai quindi l'innovazione e i risultati per cui la K-Beauty è conosciuta, insieme a un impegno reale verso la sostenibilità. E rendiamo tutto questo semplice e piacevole da usare, skincare che si ha davvero voglia di utilizzare.

Fondata nel 2020 da Sander Joonyoung van Bladel e Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda è certificata B Corp™ e membro di 1% for the Planet, con sede nel cuore di Berlino. I nostri prodotti sono disponibili tramite il nostro shop online e, da marzo 2025, presso Sephora Europa, online e in oltre 650 negozi. Con un team di oltre 140 persone straordinarie provenienti da tutto il mondo, plasmiamo ogni giorno la storia di Yepoda.

L'opportunità

Yepoda sta crescendo rapidamente in tutta Europa e si sta espandendo a livello internazionale, stiamo costruendo il nostro primo team sul campo. Questa è la tua occasione per farne parte fin dal primo giorno.

Sarai il/la rappresentante di Yepoda all'interno di Sephora Italia, non un/una Beauty Advisor, ma un ruolo commerciale sul campo. Guiderai le vendite nei tuoi punti vendita, formerai e affiancherai i team di Beauty Advisor di Sephora, gestirai la relazione con i negozi e assicurerai che la presentazione del nostro marchio sia impeccabile in negozio. In parte account executive, in parte formatore/formatrice sul campo, in parte responsabile vendite retail. Sarai responsabile della relazione, della formazione e delle vendite per un punto vendita Sephora a Milano.

I Dettagli

- Contratto: Contratto a Tempo Determinato di 6 mesi, con inizio a ottobre. Rinnovabile di comune accordo, con possibilità di diventare un ruolo permanente part-time in base alle performance.

- Orario: Part-time, 24 ore a settimana, inclusa copertura nei fine settimana. L'orario sarà confermato all'assunzione, con eventuali variazioni stagionali concordate reciprocamente.

- Trasferte: Fino al 20% del tuo tempo, soggetto a variazioni stagionali e alle esigenze del business. Copre i tuoi punti vendita oltre a supporto occasionale in occasione di eventi Yepoda. Yepoda coprirà le spese di trasferta (alloggio, trasporto e indennità pasti).

- Riporta a: EU Sales & Education Manager

- Sede: Milano, Italia. Ruolo retail sul campo (in negozio presso il punto vendita Sephora assegnato, con spostamenti se necessario)

Le Tue Attività

- Guidare le vendite nei tuoi punti vendita e raggiungere gli obiettivi mensili e trimestrali

- Vendere fianco a fianco con i Beauty Advisor Sephora per aumentare il tasso di conversione e lo scontrino medio

- Negoziare e organizzare momenti di marca dedicati, tra cui sales challenge, iniziative Beauty Hub e giornate a tema

- Formare i team di Beauty Advisor Sephora sui nostri prodotti, le routine e la storia del brand, dai brevi briefing in negozio alle sessioni complete tipo colazione

- Affiancare lo staff Sephora su tecniche di vendita, costruzione di routine e cross-selling

- Curare la formazione in occasione dei lanci prodotto, affinché ogni novità sia supportata da un team in negozio sicuro e preparato

- Assistere l'EU Retail & Education Manager in eventi formativi su larga scala e giornate stampa

- Essere il volto di Yepoda in negozio e gestire la relazione con gli Store Manager e i team BA

- Mantenere gondole ed espositori impeccabili, tester riforniti e livelli di stock adeguati a ogni visita

- Fornire report settimanali sul campo relativi a sell-out per punto vendita, merchandising e foto dei tester

- Segnalare le attività della concorrenza e gli insight dei clienti utili a definire le nostre strategie commerciali

Il Tuo Profilo

- 2-5 anni di esperienza nella vendita e formazione in cosmetica di prestigio, oppure Beauty Advisor senior pronto/a a fare il passo successivo nella propria ca

Role Summary

We're looking for a senior marketer to own our Global English Pre-QL automation program that converts intent into meetings and deals for HubSpot's Small Business Growth Specialists and pushes the boundaries of what AI-powered demand generation can do.

This role sits at the center of HubSpot's small business new business automation motion. You'll work directly on a set of programs that already account for a significant share of discovery meetings every month through signal-triggered outreach and multi-channel automation on behalf of sales. The programs are built and performing. Your job is to make them work harder: running continuous experimentation, launching net-new plays, and proactively identifying what measurably improves meetings and deals

• Strong experience in marketing automation with measurable pipeline results

• Experience designing and running growth-focused experiments

• Comfort working with sales teams and translating rep feedback into automation strategy

• Familiarity with AI-powered prospecting and personalization tools (Clay or similar)

• Experience owning large-scale outbound automation programs

title: Sponsor Dedicated CRA II/ Sr CRA - Home Based ITA
description:
Sponsor Dedicated CRA II/ Sr CRA - Home Based ITA Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver - for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture - where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose - Driven to Deliver - which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
Job Responsibilities

• Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.

• Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.

• Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.

• May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.

• Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness

As a Firmware Engineer on the Manufacturing Test team you will develop new platforms to interact with our products at the lowest levels (I2C, SPI, CAN, UART, USB, etc). Work with the Best
We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi.

At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold -concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space.

Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past.

Your Impact at LILA

Lila is hiring a Scientific Leader to build and run our experimental soft materials team, covering formulations, polymers, colloids, gels, emulsions, inks, adhesives, and coatings. You will take on a group of four scientists and grow it as the portfolio expands across formulation, rheological and scattering characterization, and polymer processing. The team turns soft-matter problems into closed-loop autonomous workflows: defining what gets measured, how it gets measured at throughput, and how the resulting data supports active learning and inverse design. • Lead and grow a group of scientists spanning formulation, polymer processing, and physical characterization; set scientific direction, develop the team, and hire against an expanding portfolio

• Work with automation and engineering colleagues to move prototype workflows into production with reliable instrument control, structured data capture, and end-to-end robotics

• Provide technical depth on new opportunities: feasibility assessment, scoping, and customer-facing scientific engagement

• Coordinate shared characterization capability and cross-domain campaigns with adjacent materials and chemistry groups

• PhD in Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, or Chemistry with 8+ years of post-degree R&D experience, or equivalent depth built through industrial practice

• Experience leading scientific teams, whether as a formal manager or as a technical lead with direct responsibility for others' work

• Deep soft-matter fundamentals: phase behavior, self-assembly, rheology, interfacial phenomena, colloid and dispersion stability, transport, cure and crosslinking

• Hands-on record formulating and characterizing multicomponent systems and translating structure-property relationships into performance

• Demonstrated delivery against external milestones with industrial partners or sponsored programs

• Data-centric experimental practice: DoE, high-throughput methods, structured capture, and working with ML colleagues as a peer rather than a customer

• Comfort moving between strategy and bench-level troubleshooting, and leading a team split across multiple sites

Bonus Points For

• Depth in one or more application areas such as adhesives and coatings, printed electronics, energy materials, or consumer and personal care

• Experience taking formulations from lab through scale-up and manufacturability review

• Python proficiency for analysis, instrument control, or workflow orchestration

• Familiarity with EHS and regulatory constraints on formulated products

title: Accounting Associate
description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

•
Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.

• We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

• Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY

• We do our best work by being CURIOUS

• We grow by remaining DYNAMIC

• Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

• At the heart of great partnerships we’ll always find EMPATHY

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE
As an Accounting Specialist, you will support the day-to-day accounting operations of the organization, with primary responsibility for Accounts Payable (A/P), Travel & Expense (T&E), and related accounting processes. This role ensures transactions are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with company policies and accounting principles.
You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders, following established procedures and escalating non-routine matters to your supervisor, to resolve outstanding items, maintain accurate financial records, support month-end close, and provide analysis of company spending. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, communicative, and comfortable owning day-to-day responsibilities and independently driving improvements to processes and controls, partnering with their supervisor on significant changes.
WHY DO WE WANT YOU
We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic, Authentic, Excellence and Empathy.
WHAT WILL YOU DO
Accounts Payable

• Manage the Accounts Payable process from invoice receipt through payment and reconciliation, following established procedures.

• Create and maintain vendor records in Sage X3, ensuring complete and accurate vendor documentation, including W-9s and other required tax information.

• Review and process invoices through Bill.com and Sage X3, ensuring accurate coding, appropriate approvals, supporting documentation, and purchase order information.

• Enter and review requests for payments, reimbursements, and other accounting transactions.

• Ensure expenses are appropriately categorized and recorded in the correct accounting period.

• Monitor invoice and payment status and proactively follow up with budget holders and other stakeholders regarding outstanding approvals or unpaid invoices.

• Identify and maintain appropriate vendor tax classifications, including C Corporations, S Corporations, individuals, and foreign entities.

• Respond to vendor inquiries and resolve invoice and payment discrepancies in a timely manner, escalating complex cases to your supervisor.

• Maintain accurate and organized A/P records and supporting documentation.

Travel & Expense (T&E)

• Manage and audit corporate credit card and cash expense submissions through Rydoo.

• Review expenses for accurate classification, appropriate supporting documentation, and compliance with the Company's T&E Policy.

• Upload approved expenses from Rydoo to Sage X3 on a weekly basis and communicate outstanding or overdue submissions to employees.

• Review and resolve expense report exceptions within established guidelines and escalate compliance concerns to your supervisor when appropriate.

• Monitor outstanding expense reports and proactively follow up with employees to ensure timely submission and resolution.

• Prepare and distribute a monthly T&E trend report, including commentary on spending patterns and policy compliance, for review by your supervisor.

• Identify recurring issues and share observations with your supervisor to support process improvements and T&E controls.

Accounting & Month-End Close

title: Senior ABM Strategist
description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.
A day in the life:
The Senior ABM Strategist leads B2B account-based marketing and go-to-market strategy across complex client accounts, with a strong emphasis on 6sense, Clay, audience strategy, account prioritization, and activation-ready planning. This role helps clients clarify who they should be targeting, why those audiences matter, how to prioritize them, and how to activate against them across marketing and sales. This person is both strategic and hands-on. One day, they may be leading a client through ICP, persona, buying committee, or target account recommendations. The next, they may be pressure-testing 6sense segment logic, advising on 6QA and buying stage strategy, building or QAing a TAL in Clay, or translating account insights into paid media, sales enablement, and campaign recommendations.
The Senior ABM Strategist is highly client-facing and must be comfortable turning ambiguous B2B challenges into clear plans, usable frameworks, activation-ready audiences, and confident next steps. They understand long sales cycles, buying committees, account-based motions, and the importance of aligning marketing, sales, RevOps, and client stakeholders around a shared GTM strategy.
Role Requirements:

• Lead B2B GTM and ABM strategy across ICP development, persona development, buying committee mapping, account prioritization, TAL development, campaign planning, and activation strategy.

• Own 6sense strategy across applicable clients, including segment creation, audience logic, buying stage interpretation, 6QA usage, account scoring, intent data, activation workflows, and reporting implications.

• Use Clay to support account enrichment, TAL development, manual verification, contact enrichment, segmentation, and account prioritization workflows.

• Translate client business goals, sales priorities, customer data, stakeholder interviews, market signals, and platform insights into clear GTM recommendations.

• Build and pressure-test ICPs, personas, TALs, account tiers, and campaign strategies to ensure they are commercially relevant, defensible, and actionable.

• Develop ABM strategies for strategic, enterprise, and named-account motions, including 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many account-based programs.

title: Manager, Sales Development & Enablement
description:
ABOUT STREAM

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Manager, Sales Development & Enablement to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the SDR team's targets, its people, and the enablement program that decides how fast new reps ramp.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in our Boulder office, with 3 days a week in the office.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

You'll lead a team of 6+ SDRs and report to the VP of Revenue Operations. Half of this job is management: coaching, hiring, and holding the team to its number. The other half is enablement: you own the onboarding curriculum, certification and playbook, so you build how the team works instead of inheriting it. You'll work closely with Account Executives and Sales leadership on pipeline quality, and with Marketing, Product Marketing and Sales Engineering to keep messaging current as we ship. Success is measured by team quota attainment, ramp time, and the quality of the pipeline the team hands to AEs.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the number: set team objectives against the revenue plan, track monthly, quarterly and annual targets, and report performance to Sales leadership.

- Lead the team: run one-to-ones, call coaching, performance reviews and development plans for SDRs at every level, with clear accountability for results.

- Build enablement: design and run the onboarding curriculum, certification path, call-coaching framework and ongoing skills programs.

- Keep the playbook current: own messaging, objection handling and qualification criteria, and update them with Product Marketing, Marketing and Sales Engineering as products and the market change.

- Hire and scale: partner with Talent Acquisition to run the interview process, set the bar, and onboard new SDRs.

- Run coverage: allocate territories, accounts and resources across the team, and adjust as segments and priorities shift.

- Manage with data: use Salesforce and Gong to diagnose performance, run call reviews, improve conversion, ramp time and meeting quality, and agree hand-off and pipeline standards with AE leadership.

ABOUT YOU

You're a manager who still gets on the phone. When a rep is stuck, you show them what good sounds like rather than describing it. You like building the system as much as running the team: a curriculum, a certification, a playbook new hires can actually use. Stream is a scale-up, so priorities move and not everything is defined yet. If you want a finished sales machine to manage, this probably isn't the role. If you want to build one, it is.

YOU HAVE:

- 1+ years managing a sales development or inside sales team, with direct accountability for team quota

- 3+ years in SaaS sales, including time as an SDR or in a comparable outbound role

- Experience building or substantially improving enablement assets: onboarding programs, playbooks, certification or coaching frameworks

- A track record of hiring, ramping and retaining early-career sales talent

- Fluency with Claude, Salesforce, Gong and modern prospecting and engagement tools, and the habit of managing performance with data

- A hands-on coaching style, with the credibility to get on a call and set the standard yourself

BONUS POINTS:

- Growing an outbound team at an API-led, developer-focused or infrastructure SaaS company

- Formal sales enablement experience, or owning an enablement function alongside a management role

- Managing across US and EMEA time zones

- Embedding a sales methodology (MEDDIC, Command of the Message or similar) in a curriculum

- Experience as an SDR at a high-growth company

description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com http://www.peek.com.

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

Do you love crafting beautiful and functional customer experiences? Want to work on interesting technical problems around integrations and payments? Do you have a passion for Elixir and functional programming with a focus on building large, complex systems at scale? Peek is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer. The ideal candidate has 5+ years of development experience with Elixir, experience working with GraphQL APIs, MySQL, and familiarity with messaging queues such as RabbitMQ. In this role you will have the opportunity to take ownership of critical product areas and use AI tools as a force multiplier on top of your strong fundamentals.

 

Our engineering group works on several different products and systems: our Peek Pro operations management suite, embeddable scheduling & booking flows, and custom development services for our enterprise customers. This role will primarily focus on Connectivity via third party integrations and the Peek Pro “App Store”, and secondarily focus on payments-related initiatives.

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer who works AI-first. That means you treat AI as a core part of how you build software and break down ambiguous problems, including delegating tasks to agents, reviewing their work critically, and course-correcting when things go sideways. You'll design and operate complex agent orchestration systems, develop patterns for human-agent collaboration, and ship real product features primarily through agent-assisted development in collaboration with human colleagues.

We work collaboratively, move fast, and value technical quality. If you are excited about the challenge of building an incredible product while working alongside a great engineering team, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What we’re looking for

- Strong backend fundamentals in Elixir: API design, data modeling, SQL, service reliability, and debugging production issues.

- Emphasis on creating scalable and reliable backend systems that integrate seamlessly with multiple services and products with an attention to high-quality code.

- A drive for exploring and leading new approaches to complex problems via collaboration with multiple stakeholders across Product, Design, and Engineering, particularly amongst one’s peers.

- Adaptability to the changing tech industry: demonstrated daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow.

- Ability to evaluate AI-generated code critically: you catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written.

- Strong system design instincts: you think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail.

- Clear and empathetic communicator: you flag when a spec has holes, you can articulate why you made a technical choice, you enjoy collaboration and seek to understand different perspectives, and you are constructive in any disagreements.

- Self-motivation and ownership: you will push your work forward without prompting and look for ways to unblock yourself and the team on business priorities; you enjoy ownership over your work

title: Forensic Analyst
description:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. Our global Forensics team collects, preserves, and analyzes the data that legal matters depend on, and it runs around the clock across the US, EMEA, and APAC
As a Forensic Analyst based in India, you join the India-based group of that global team and work US Central hours, including weekends, so our clients have forensic coverage when they need it. You start with high-volume, well-defined work: cloud data collections, mobile device report exports, chain of custody documentation, and ticket triage, all under structured training from the US team. As your skills and certifications build, your ownership grows, from supervised tickets to independent handling of assigned ticket types to standalone weekend coverage. This is a role for someone who wants to build a career in digital forensics inside a global practice, with a clear path and real responsibility early.
What You'll Be Doing
Collections and Evidence Handling

• Process cloud data collections from Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and similar sources following KLD Standard Operating Procedures.

• Generate mobile device report exports from forensic tool outputs (Cellebrite, Oxygen Forensics, Magnet AXIOM, or equivalent).

• Maintain chain of custody documentation and evidence handling logs to the KLD standard, and keep case records and ticket notes complete and current.

• Travel within India for onsite data collection or evidence and media handover when a matter requires it.

Ticket Triage and Weekend Coverage

• Triage, tag, and route incoming forensics tickets in KLD's work management system, and claim and action Tier 1 and Tier 2 requests within SLA, with quality control requests taking priority over new tickets of the same tier.

• Monitor the collections and escalation channels during your shift, and alert the on-duty Weekend Coverage Manager to priority requests.

• Execute time-dependent, scheduled, and prioritized cloud and remote collections during weekend coverage windows.

• Escalate anything client-facing, legally sensitive, or outside a defined SOP to the US team, and provide clear handoff notes at the end of every shift so service continues without interruption.

Learning, Certification, and Growth

• Complete structured training, shadowing, and certification milestones set by the US team, and work independently on each ticket type once certified.

• Contribute to and maintain the internal knowledge base and SOP documentation as you learn.

• Build toward standalone coverage of routine ticket types and, over time, broader collection and analysis work as trust and skills grow.

• Lead with the four values. Client is Always in the Room. Own the Outcome. Better Every Day. Deliver Results Together.

What You Should Already Have

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 to 3 years in digital forensics, IT operations, a helpdesk or ticketing environment, or a similar structured technical role. Strong aptitude and attention to detail can substitute for direct forensics experience.

• Exposure to forensic tools (Cellebrite, Magnet AXIOM, EnCase, FTK, Oxygen Forensics, X-Ways, or similar) is a plus, not a requirement. Training is provided.

• Basic scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) is a plus, not a requirement.

• Strong written English for documentation and ticket notes. Fluent spoken English for daily work with US, UK, and APAC colleagues. Client-facing communication is required at the start.

• Comfortable with a sustained US-aligned night schedule that includes Saturday and Sunday, and able to work independently once certified while following escalation protocols.

• Able and willing to travel within India for onsite collection or media handover as required.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll be a customer-facing member of our Tier 2 support team, handling product issues that require deeper troubleshooting or coordination beyond frontline support.
You’ll use company's procedures and diagnostic tools to investigate issues, guide customers through next steps by phone, email, and SMS, and coordinate with service partners when a field visit is needed. When an issue requires Engineering input, you’ll gather the relevant findings and provide a clear escalation. You’ll remain responsible for customer communication and follow-up as the case moves toward resolution.
What you'll own:

• Troubleshoot known product issues with customers using company's procedures and diagnostic tools.

• Ask effective diagnostic questions, document findings, and determine the appropriate next step.

• Own assigned cases through resolution, including timely customer updates and follow-up.

• Coordinate customers, service partners, and internal teams to arrange field visits and track outcomes.

• Escalate complex issues to Engineering with a clear summary of symptoms, troubleshooting completed, and supporting information.

• Maintain accurate case records in Zendesk, Jira, and other support systems.

• Identify gaps or recurring issues and help improve troubleshooting procedures, support documentation, and tools.

• Work closely with Customer Experience, Field, and Engineering as support processes evolve

Requirements

• 3+ years in customer-facing technical support or remote troubleshooting. Hardware, connected devices, appliances, or field service experience is a strong plus.

• Must have prior US-hours experience.

• Has helped build or standardize processes (SOPs, macros, knowledge base, escalation paths). Can work in gray areas without a script.

• Comfortable talking to both non-technical end users and engineers or field techs.

• Individual contributor, not a team lead, but brings enough seniority.

• Spanish/English bilingual is strongly preferred.

Nice to have:

• HVAC experience is last on the nice-to-have list. Technical aptitude, critical thinking, and phone skills come first.

As Senior Director, Product Management for EU, you will be Veeva Nitro's senior product presence in Europe. title: Senior Data Scientist - Product

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role
As a Senior Data Scientist for Product at Legora you will turn data into decisions. You'll sit close to the business, taking questions end-to-end: shaping the metric, modelling the data in dbt, running the analysis, and making the recommendation. You'll pull in new data sources when you need to. Insights are useful; impact is what we hire for.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

There's no single profile we hire for. Some of us are strongest at data modelling and analytics engineering, some at experimentation and causal inference, some at machine learning, some at stakeholder influence. You'll likely be excellent at one or two of these and competent across the rest. That's the bar.

- Product: instrumentation, feature adoption, user behaviour, A/B testing, shaping the roadmap with PMs and designers.

- Finance & RevOps: ARR, NRR, forecasting, board reporting, pricing analytics across a 40-country footprint, and unit economics for an AI-native product.

- Growth & Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution, campaign measurement, lifecycle analytics, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

- GTM & Customer Success: pipeline analytics, customer health, expansion signals, and retention drivers in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

You'll partner directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and GTM, most of whom are unusually data-fluent and will happily open a SQL editor with you. Your work will directly influence how we prioritise, how we sell, how we price, and how we build.

- Conduct deep-dive analyses on the questions that move the business, and proactively surface the questions nobody is asking yet.
